title: Prompt Settlement Credit on HomeFlood Closing Balances
content:
**Rule.** A cancelled HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies account settled soon after the policy was closed earns a prompt-settlement credit. The time is counted in calendar days from the date the policy was closed — the date the cancellation was processed, shown on the policy as its closed date — to the payment date.

| Closing payment made | Prompt-settlement credit |
|---|---|
| no more than 7 days after the policy was closed | 1 percent of the account balance |
| more than 7 but no more than 30 days after | 0.5 percent of the account balance |
| later | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is taken off the closing payment. The account balance is every premium item charged and refund paid on the policy, less every payment received and credit given.

**The payment date.** The payment date is the day the customer makes the closing payment, and every length of time counted to the payment date ends on that day.

## Boundary cases

| Days after closing | Credit |
|---|---|
| 7 | 1 percent |
| 8 | 0.5 percent |
| 30 | 0.5 percent |
| 31 | none |

*Hypothetical illustration:* an account balance of 250.00 settled 5 days after closing earns 2.50.
